newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Brent steady, OPEC comments support NYMEX.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Brent steady, OPEC comments support NYMEX.

text.p: Brent crude futures in Asia were steady around the London close at midday on Monday, but NYMEX crudes were firmer in response to OPEC comments.
June Brent was quoted at $18.90/$19.17 per barrel, after London settled at $18.93.
But NYMEX crude futures for June were last traded on ACCESS at $20.58, up 15 cents from New York on Friday.
Over the weekend, OPEC President Abdullah Salem Al-Badri said he believed most members wanted to roll over current quotas at the group's next ministerial meeting in June.
Badri and six other ministers met in Iran and agreed oil markets were over supplied and that they should act to bolster prices.
Technically, Brent was now looking to break above the psychological $19.00 after having so much trouble breaking above a resistance area of $18.77.
